name: developer-system-bootstrap-ops
description: Develop, audit, build, bootstrap, and synchronize OGENIC workflows across connected cloud services.

interface.shortDescription: Build, audit, bootstrap, and sync OGENIC workflows.
interface.longDescription: Routes /WF commands across Drive, GitHub, Notion, Shopify, Cloudflare, and secret-management workflows. It reads before writing, preserves recoverable versions, separates secret metadata from secret values, and verifies builds before deployment.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Developer System-Bootstrap Ops to inspect the target, build or synchronize the requested workflow, audit the result, and save a recoverable version.
